description: This file defines the ClusterDiagnosticsService class which interacts with Orleans grains to gather and process diagnostic data such as grain call frequencies, host details, and grain details. It includes methods for retrieving call graphs, resetting internal state, and managing grain and host vertices.

classes.name: ClusterDiagnosticsService
classes.description: A service class that interacts with Orleans grains to collect and process diagnostic data related to grain call frequencies, hosts, and grains, providing methods to retrieve call graphs and reset internal state.

classes.name: CallGraph
classes.description: A record class representing the call graph data structure, including lists of grain nodes, host nodes, edges, and maximum values for edges and activations.

classes.name: HostNode
classes.description: A record struct representing a host node with its name and activation count.

classes.name: GraphNode
classes.description: A record struct representing a graph node with its name, key, host, and weight.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: A record struct representing an edge key with source and target identifiers.

classes.name: GraphEdge
classes.description: A record struct representing an edge in the graph with source, target, and weight.

methods.name: GetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and constructs the call graph data including grain and host details, edges, and maximum values.

methods.name: ResetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously resets the internal state of the diagnostics service, deactivating certain grains.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets internal dictionaries and collections to their initial empty state.

methods.name: GetGrainVertex
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a grain vertex entry for a given grain ID and host key.

methods.name: GetHostVertex
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a host vertex index for a given silo address.

methods.name: UpdateEdge
methods.description: Updates the call count for an edge identified by a key, incrementing its value.
